_comment: "Draw a card then discard a random card. IF A CARD WITH 6 OR MORE {p} IS DISCARDED THIS WAY, this gets +1{d}." The payoff was a SEPARATE ON_DEFEND ability gated on CARD_IN_ZONE zone:HAND filter:{power_gte:6} -- three things wrong at once. It asks whether such a card is IN HAND, not whether one was discarded, and those differ precisely when the random discard misses. 'filter' as a nested dict was not a key CARD_IN_ZONE read, so there was no power test at all and the condition reduced to 'is your hand non-empty' -- +1{d} on essentially every defend. And being a separate ability it could not see what the first one discarded. DISCARD_RANDOM now records what it took; the gate reads that. The +1{d} also went to the defending TOTAL rather than to this card. Temper is a printed keyword.
